items.text: Ladd McConkey rib injury day-to-day per Harbaugh; monitor week, status up in air vs Raiders.
items.why: Left game early; Harbaugh wants to see how feels
items.implication: Potential miss or limited Week 2; LAC WR depth up

items.text: Malik Nabers in first game since ACL+meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets (31% share), 6-69-0, emerged healthy.
items.why: Played after late decision; healthy post-game
items.implication: Viable WR start ROS with target share; decoy risk limited

items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring not serious; day-to-day, MRI; would have returned if playoff game. Coach confirms DTD.
items.why: Left early but not serious; prior hamstring history
items.implication: Monitor practice; likely play Week 2 vs NO or limited

items.text: Lions offense ultra-concentrated: Gibbs, ARSB, LaPorta, Jamo 65/70 opps (93%). No RB2/WR3/TE2 usage.
items.why: As expected for good offense; no committee
items.implication: Lock in top4; fade others in DET

items.text: Colston Loveland disappointing box but 92% routes; two almost-plays; buy-low all the Loveland.
items.why: High route % despite quiet day; preseason belief in Bears TE

items.text: Raiders HC Kubiak considers Brock Bowers day-to-day after meniscus trim.
items.implication: Possible return soon; Mayer/others elevated if sits

items.text: Travis Etienne did not dominate with Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53/26/15 Etienne/Miller/Donaldson; routes 24/5/7; opps 18/9/4.
items.why: Kamara not expected/not play; Etienne lead but committee
items.implication: Etienne RB2/flex but not smash; Miller handcuff value
items.opportunity: Etienne 53 snaps/24 routes/18 opps lead role

items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE; risk/reward RB2 start everywhere as Cards wouldn't active if worried.
items.why: Officially active; ankle not limiting enough
items.implication: Start as RB2 with upside in Cards offense

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze officially active (calf).
items.implication: Full WR role in Bears offense

items.text: Weekend: Love/Odunze expected; Kamara not; Nabers no news (later active). Watching Flowers/McConkey/BTJ/Murray/Lane etc.
Bucky Irving 22.3 PPR overstated vs usage (8 carries, 21 routes, 7 targets all caught) but only RB carry inside 10, out-routed Gainwell 21-13, looked healthy. Good vs CLE.
Dalton Kincaid over PCL: 42/57 snaps (74%), 22 routes on 32 Allen dropbacks (69%). Moves needle when on field.
Panthers RB: Hubbard 48 snaps/25 routes/13 opps vs Brooks 13/5/6. Brooks had early week groin tweak.
Isaiah Likely breakout SZN well under way.
items.why: Strong Week 1 showing in Ravens TE role
